description: This file defines the CustomerAttributeDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface to perform data access operations related to CustomerAttribute entities. It declares methods for retrieving CustomerAttribute instances based on various identifiers such as option ID, option value ID, and customer ID, scoped to a MerchantStore context.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDao
classes.description: An interface for CustomerAttribute data access object, extending generic DAO functionality with methods specific for CustomerAttribute lookup by various identifiers.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on MerchantStore, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific option value ID within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific option ID within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes linked to a specific customer within a MerchantStore.
